definition: In this social-cognition context, reactive refers to forming inferences about another person’s thoughts, feelings, or intentions in response to immediate demands rather than keeping a detailed, continuously updated model all the time. It describes a flexible, efficiency-oriented way of reasoning about others when cognitive resources are limited.
